name: archviz-map
description: Web 3D project map - all client projects on one map, models streamed by viewport
comment: The app itself has no runtime dependencies - it loads MapLibre and three.js from a CDN, and serve.mjs serves it with nothing installed. These are for the model and image pipeline: tools/prepare-model.mjs on the command line, and the same code behind the /admin uploads. sharp is pinned to the major that @gltf-transform/functions pulls in through ndarray-pixels - two copies of sharp in one process fail to load their native binding on Windows.
